reason: The wrong output is what §4.10 described before REC-135 and REC-137: six sections, no Id line, no Governs, Relations, Attribution, Assumptions or Evidence. It is a legal-looking record and it has silently deleted six fields the same implementation can read back. That is the defect REC-135 makes a conformance failure rather than an accepted limitation.
